summary: Baseline build shows the Vite main social entry is still the dominant bundle. Search/Map discovery, media upload runtime, orders runtime, image compressor, public route preload, and Firebase vendor are already split. The recommended first true static-import cut is the basic overlay modal renderer group from shell-ui-runtime-cluster because it is not needed for /feed first paint and can be loaded only when profile/chat/post/likes modals render.

generatedChunks.purpose: Shared Firebase vendor chunk imported by the main entry.
Public route cache early preload, already dynamic.

topStaticImportGroupsStillInSocialAppJs.reasonStillStatic: Required for current authenticated startup/session/bootstrap path.
Current shell and /feed first paint are synchronous.
Feed is the default visible route and cannot be lazily replaced without a first-paint behavior decision.
Public/Menu/QR and profile route behavior are explicitly out of scope for this pass.
Heart CRM, /leads, /customers, and /admin/staff are explicitly out of scope.
Currently in the main entry even though basic profile/chat/post/likes modal rendering is not needed for /feed first paint.

safeCandidateCuts.expectedMainEntryEffect: Remove basic profile/chat/post/likes modal render markup from the main entry and create a new dynamic chunk.
safeCandidateCuts.whySafe: The functions renderChatModalCore, renderProfileModalCore, renderPostModalCore, and renderLikesModalCore are not needed until a modal is opened. Existing overlay state, event binders, Firebase listeners, and modal source functions remain unchanged.

safeCandidateCuts.expectedMainEntryEffect: Small main-entry reduction for settings route.
safeCandidateCuts.whyNotFirst: Smaller effect than overlay-basic-render-utils and would add a loading edge to direct /settings.

safeCandidateCuts.expectedMainEntryEffect: Very small main-entry reduction for notifications route.
safeCandidateCuts.whyNotFirst: Reduction is likely not meaningful enough for this task.

unsafeCandidateCuts.reason: Needed for current /feed first paint. Lazy-loading it would require a first-paint placeholder or async render contract.
Public Menu/QR/cart/order behavior and payloads are explicitly out of scope.
Heart CRM, /leads, /customers, /admin/staff, and /staff behavior are explicitly out of scope.
businessAccounts behavior is explicitly out of scope.
Waiter/Kitchen is explicitly out of scope.
Firebase paths, query shapes, and payloads must not change.

recommendedFirstTrueStaticImportRemoval.loadBoundary: Only when state.profileModal, state.chatModal, state.postModal, or state.likesModal is open and its renderer is requested.
recommendedFirstTrueStaticImportRemoval.sourceOfTruth: Existing renderChatModalCore, renderProfileModalCore, renderPostModalCore, and renderLikesModalCore functions remain in overlay-basic-render-utils.js.

expectedSizeReduction.mainEntryRawKB: Expected several KB raw reduction, with a new dynamic overlay-basic-render-utils chunk. Exact accepted value must be verified by post-change build.
expectedSizeReduction.mainEntryGzipKB: Expected small but real gzip reduction.
